items.why: AMD slid as tech stocks struggled broadly, with the Nasdaq under pressure while oil spiked and yields climbed.
Bitcoin dropped alongside a risk-off tape as oil surged 5% and equities slid on rising yields and geopolitical tension.
Crude jumped over 5% after a fresh tanker attack and reports that war could resume in Iran, with the Pentagon preparing for possible military action.
Volatility rose as the S&P 500 slid on climbing Treasury yields and war comments pressuring the Dow.

market_note: Equities pointed lower midday as oil spiked over 5% and the 10-year yield ticked up.
summary: Stocks slid Thursday as oil spiked more than 5% on Iran war fears and Treasury yields kept climbing, with tech lagging and the VIX jumping.
